scope: Execution-only clarification for Phase 3; no scientific model, task, k, seed, correctness, output-cap, repetition, or estimator choice is changed.

pairing_and_order.baseline_policy: One TARGET_BASELINE observation is shared by the CPU and NPU paired comparisons for the same task and repetition.
pairing_and_order.condition_order: For every formal unit, independently shuffle all three conditions using Python random.Random with the already-frozen condition-order seed; persist the complete schedule before the first formal generation.
pairing_and_order.device_randomization: CPU_DRAFT_K2 and NPU_DRAFT_K2 participate in the same three-condition shuffle; neither device is always first.
pairing_and_order.small_gate_interpretation: Each draft-device path must independently achieve 18/18 token-exact pairs. The shared baseline is compared independently with each device output.

session_and_warmup.process_policy: Use one orchestrating process per campaign stage. Load the target once and load each eligible draft runtime once; do not reload inside a measured generation.
session_and_warmup.warmup: Before each stage, perform one complete NON_FORMAL INVALID_FOR_CLAIMS generation for each condition in the order TARGET_BASELINE, CPU_DRAFT_K2, NPU_DRAFT_K2. Warm-up uses a task outside both frozen formal task sets and is excluded from every estimator.
session_and_warmup.state_reset: Reset target and draft KV/state to an empty sequence before every condition observation. Reuse compiled models and allocated runtime objects, but never reuse prompt or generated KV state across observations.
session_and_warmup.cache_policy: Reuse only the already-qualified NPU compilation cache. Compilation, model loading, and cache construction are outside all measured boundaries.

runtime_and_algorithm.target_backend: Frozen llama.cpp b10839 commit 0cae43063cf15170e91a2ff4d034da0ecef4a1b2, Qwen3-8B Q8_0, explicit Vulkan0, all model and KV layers offloaded as in the Phase-1/2 target qualification.
runtime_and_algorithm.draft_backend: The frozen common OpenVINO INT4 IR is compiled explicitly to CPU or NPU. AUTO, MULTI, HETERO and fallback are forbidden.
runtime_and_algorithm.speculative_algorithm: Reuse the repository/llama.cpp draft-simple greedy k=2 semantics: autoregressive draft proposal; one ordered target verification of proposed positions; accept the matching prefix; at first mismatch commit the target correction token; when both proposals match, follow the existing target bonus-token behavior; repeat to the frozen termination condition.
runtime_and_algorithm.verification_backend: The same explicit Vulkan0 target context performs greedy verification. Verification uses the serialized correctness-admissible path; no unqualified batched shortcut is allowed.

timing_and_accounting.synchronization: All device calls are synchronous. Each interval ends only after the corresponding runtime call has completed.
timing_and_accounting.end_to_end_boundary: Host perf_counter_ns immediately before the first decode/proposal operation after prompt prefill and immediately after the final generated token is committed. Model load, compilation, prompt tokenization and warm-up are excluded; prompt prefill is recorded separately and excluded from the primary decode speedup to preserve the frozen generated-token comparison.
timing_and_accounting.baseline_boundary: The same post-prefill-to-final-commit host boundary as speculative conditions.
timing_and_accounting.draft_time: Measured synchronous OpenVINO proposal calls only.
timing_and_accounting.verification_time: Measured synchronous target verification/decode calls only.
timing_and_accounting.orchestration_handoff: Derived residual only: end_to_end - draft_time - verification_time. Label DERIVED, never directly measured.
timing_and_accounting.acceptance: Count every proposed draft token and the ordered matching prefix. A round accepting zero, one, or two draft tokens is classified by the number of matching draft tokens before the first mismatch.
timing_and_accounting.committed_progress_C: For each round, count all output tokens committed by that round, including target correction or qualified bonus behavior. Report arithmetic mean committed output tokens per round and its distribution.
timing_and_accounting.ttft: Record only when the boundary can be applied identically across all three conditions; otherwise mark NOT_ADMISSIBLE.

correctness.comparison: Generated token IDs only; prompt excluded; first divergence is FAIL.
correctness.small_gate_pass: 18/18 exact independently for CPU_DRAFT_K2 and NPU_DRAFT_K2.
correctness.full_admission: Any divergent HumanEval30 pair makes that device path DIAGNOSTIC_ONLY for speed claims.
correctness.no_substitution: Semantic similarity or Python functional correctness cannot replace token-exact comparison.

failure_policy.retain: Retain stdout, stderr, partial JSON, schedule position and environment evidence for every failure.
failure_policy.retry: No automatic retry enters the authoritative slot. A retry is permitted only for an externally documented interruption unrelated to model output; both attempts remain archived and the retry is flagged.
failure_policy.runtime_failure: A device/runtime failure stops that path. Do not tune, fall back, change precision or change device.
failure_policy.wrong_device: Any binding mismatch fails closed before formal generation and produces no admissible timing.

affinity_and_binding.target_gpu: Vulkan0 / Intel Arc B390; require runtime log evidence of 37/37 model layers and all KV layers on Vulkan0 for every session.
affinity_and_binding.cpu_draft: Require requested_device=CPU and OpenVINO EXECUTION_DEVICES=[CPU] in each session manifest.
affinity_and_binding.npu_draft: Require requested_device=NPU and OpenVINO EXECUTION_DEVICES=[NPU] in each session manifest.

energy.cpu_end_to_end: NOT_CLAIMED: no frozen whole-system boundary exists.

dry_run.task_policy: Use a HumanEval task outside the six-task gate and HumanEval30 membership.
